contact.description: Can't find what you're looking for? Our community is always happy to help. Reach out on any of these channels and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

enduranceChampion.content: A special title given to the participant who held the most-recent-gesture position for the longest uninterrupted interval within a Performance Cycle.

chronoWarrior.content: An even rarer title — the participant who held the Endurance Champion position for the longest consecutive interval.

calibrationWindow.content: A price-discovery window where Gesture Cost starts high and descends over time from the Calibration Ceiling toward the Calibration Floor. The longer you wait, the lower the cost.

cosmicCouncil.content: The on-chain coordination body where CST holders submit Coordination Proposals and express Support or Opposition — for example, selecting the Public Goods Beneficiary that receives each cycle's public-goods allocation.

cst.content: CST tokens — the ERC-20 tokens imprinted with every gesture. Used on the Cosmic Council and as alternative gesture currency.

erc20.content: A widely used Ethereum token standard for fungible (interchangeable) tokens.

erc721.content: The Ethereum token standard for non-fungible tokens (NFTs) — each token is unique.

layer2.content: A secondary protocol built on top of Ethereum that processes transactions faster and cheaper while inheriting Ethereum's security.

rollup.content: A Layer 2 technique that bundles many transactions into one, dramatically reducing costs while keeping Ethereum-level security.

randomWalkNft.content: A sister NFT collection. Attaching one to an ETH gesture grants a one-time 50% ETH Gesture Cost reduction.

renounceOwnership.content: An irreversible smart-contract action that permanently gives up the team's ability to change protocol parameters.
